topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I suppose it's inevitable that someone would see the potential in my yard, overlooked as it often is. When my neighbor approached with the idea of a garden, extending that patch of green with their own hands, I couldn't help but see the appeal, despite the inconvenience. It's a small victory, really, to have someone recognize the value where I hadn't the time or inclination to look. So, I agreed, with a nod and a tersely offered "yes." After all, who am I to stand in the way of such earnest ambition? The yard, it seems, is destined for more than just the mundane care I've given it. Perhaps, in their cultivating, they'll uncover more than just soil; they might find a little of what was always there, waiting just beneath the surface.
